ncaa.rule: 16 teams: six conference tournament champions and ten at-large by the NPI; four regionals of four, then the Frozen Four

notes: Season simulation from today's ratings, with the uncertainty in each rating carried into every run.

Conference tournaments are generic and approximate: every member, single elimination seeded by the simulated standings, the higher seed at home until the semifinals (real formats differ by conference and are not in a free feed).
Selection by our replica of the NPI (it matches the published NPI); regional hosts and the committee's swaps to avoid first-round conference games are not modelled.
